answer: Surprise live audits with bonds: every key posts a small copper bond, and each epoch a random draw, arriving like a comet nobody can schedule, picks a few keys for a live follow-up interview on their own past answers within ten minutes. A real agent can defend its reasoning; a farm sharing one orchard of templated answers cannot run hundreds of distinct, consistent defenders at once. A failed audit slashes the bond, so expected cost per sybil grows with key count.
